ranking.note: Raised to P1: security flaw in the release-binary verification script, responsibly disclosed, lets revoked/expired keys alone satisfy the quorum users rely on
Raised to P2 for consistency with #36105: the wrapper is entirely unable to launch its binaries on supported distros (Arch), a comparable platform failure
Moved up: seed generation is release tooling that affects real deployments per this category, and an IndexError aborts the run
Moved down: large speedup but confined to a specialized fuzz-determinism workflow, below tool fixes that operators and CLI users feel
Lowered to P4 to match #31888: both are bug fixes in the same niche linearize contrib script and cannot sit in different bands
Lowered to P4: test-only coverage stacked on #36105, which carries the actual problem; adds regression protection rather than fixing anything
Lowered to P4: internal refactoring aid with no stated user payoff, and the author prefers abandoning the approach

inconsistencies: #36157 and #31888 both patch contrib/linearize/linearize-data.py and will likely conflict; review #36157 first (one-line infinite-loop fix with a reproduction) before the rewrite-support change in #31888.
#35608 and #35809 modify the same deterministic-fuzz-coverage tool by the same author; #35608 (the runtime reduction) should be reviewed first, with #35809 layered on top.
Chain: #36105 contains the ExecVp runtime fix and #36190 only adds the Windows tests for it — #36105 must be reviewed/merged first, and #36190 has no standalone value.
#35903 may be moot: a reviewer asked whether #35958 makes the non-printable msgtype condition unreachable; that question should be settled before spending review time.
#19460 depends on the multiprocess branch (#10102/#29409) and is the base for #19461; its value is as a prerequisite, so it should not be assessed as a standalone feature.
result.notes: Only one PR here has consequences beyond developer convenience (#36293, release-binary verification), so P1 is used once. The two bitcoin-wrapper platform failures form the P2 tier; the bulk of the category is developer- and contrib-script work, correctly spread across P3/P4, with niche contrib scripts (linearize, message-capture) held at P4 per the category's ordering.
